falsification_conditions.condition: The engine's primary risk index closes 8% or more below today's close within 14 days and finishes below the August 2024 analog invalidation low (the swing low that defines bottom_2024_aug).
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The bottom analog failed. UNKNOWN/HOLD was wrong; the correct call was risk-off, not a hold on a bottom-like pattern.

falsification_conditions.condition: Blowoff score prints at or above 70 on three consecutive tracked sessions within 14 days.
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: Regime is a blowoff/top, not a 37-score bottom analog. The HOLD and the 78% bottom_2024_aug match are invalidated.

falsification_conditions.condition: Pattern-match similarity to bottom_2024_aug falls below 40% while similarity to any tracked top or breakdown template rises above 75% within 14 days.
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The bottom identification was false. UNKNOWN anchored on that analog is the wrong verdict; the tape resolved into a top/breakdown regime.

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
